data.name: Bhagwan
data.long_meaning: Bhagwan is a Sanskrit name meaning 'God', 'Lord', or 'Blessed One'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhag', which means 'to share' or 'to bless'. In Hinduism, Bhagwan is used as a title for various deities, including Vishnu, Shiva, and Ganesha.
